must_fix: GM.md §6/§7 misstates its own cited primary source: it claims 'Automotive-only debt of just $15.98bn against Automotive cash + marketable securities of $24.7bn -- i.e., Automotive is net-cash positive by roughly $8.7bn' from GM's Q2 2026 earnings release (accession in GM.md source #2, gmq22026pressreleaseandfin.htm). I re-fetched that exact filing: the Combining Balance Sheet shows Automotive cash and cash equivalents $15,147m + Automotive marketable debt securities $4,503m = $19,650m (not $24.7bn), against Automotive debt of $15,979m -- i.e. automotive net cash is actually about +$3.67bn (the release's own stated 'Net automotive liquidity position: $3,671 million'), not +$8.7bn. This is the load-bearing number in GM's §7 argument for overriding V1's 'excessive' valuation verdict on a full-conviction, 5.8%-weight holding. Fix: correct GM.md §6/§7 to the sourced $19.65bn/+$3.67bn figures, rebuild the EV bridge (EV rises by ~$5bn, from ~$66.5bn to ~$71.5bn) and reverse-DCF conclusion, and state explicitly whether the INCLUDE verdict and weight survive the corrected number (the qualitative case -- three guidance raises, shrinking EV losses, tariff relief -- may still hold, but the specific 'net-cash positive by $8.7bn' claim must not stand uncorrected).

Five of the twenty holdings (GM, ADP, RJF, DOV, HBAN -- 29.2% of the sleeve by weight: 5.8+7.1+4.7+7.4+4.2) are new to this loop's full-conviction list and are still marked 'not yet checked' in FINAL_REPORT.md Appendix A.5, exactly the same must-fix (#4) this audit raised last loop about a *different* set of nine new holdings (which were then covered by DA6). The pattern is now structural: every loop's newest full-conviction names enter the frozen, audited build before any independent fact-check exists, and the audit is the first check -- which is how the GM error above reached a full-weight position undetected. Fix: run a DA7 pass (mirroring DA4/DA5/DA6's method) on these five dossiers before the next freeze, and change the process so a name cannot enter the frozen sleeve at full weight without at least one independent fact-check pass completed first (not just queued for the next loop).
